description: This file contains unit tests for the tracing system in the project, including tests for trace buffer reading, parsing, and category management, utilizing Google Test framework.

classes.name: ServerCyclicBuffer01
classes.description: A custom cyclic buffer class used in tests, inheriting from CyclicBuffer, with overridden GetReadSize method.

methods.name: ReadTraceString
methods.description: Reads a null-terminated string from a buffer starting at a given offset.

methods.name: ParseTraceData
methods.description: Parses trace data from a buffer into a TraceData structure, reading strings and header information.

methods.name: DebugCheckIfConsistent
methods.description: Checks the consistency of the trace buffer data by verifying entry sizes and total length.

methods.name: CreateTraceBuffer
methods.description: Creates a directory for trace buffer files.
